speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and have an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any unexplained fevers or itching, and have you noticed any pain in your abdomen that is relieved by eating? I would also like to examine your abdomen for any masses or tenderness.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.
